Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide ng.gov.digitalhealth.fhir-ig

NigeriaCore

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/ImplementationGuide/ng.gov.digitalhealth.fhir-ig

The Nigeria Core Implementation Guide defines the minimum set of FHIR RESTful interactions for each of the Nigeria Core Profiles to access patient data. The Profiles are updated monthly to support the latest requirements from The Nigeria Digital in Health Initiative under Sector Wide Approach (SWaP) for Health Information in Nigeria.
